description: Check whether a home's electrical panel has capacity for an EV charger. Use when a user asks if their panel or breaker box can handle an EV charger, or whether they need a panel upgrade or load management. Returns a verdict (fits / tight / does-not-fit), amps, and a plain-language explanation.

appliances.description: Major appliances with nameplate VA. Optional; improves accuracy.

va.description: Nameplate VA (volts x amps) from the label

charger_amps.description: Charger charging current in amps, e.g. 32, 40, 48, 80

main_breaker_amps.description: Main breaker rating of the panel in amps, e.g. 100, 150, 200

square_footage.description: Home size in square feet. Omit if unknown (assumes 2000).

name: check_panel_capacity
title: Check Panel Capacity
